readme: Six observable charge features, not true electrode states
label_budget: 2 target-train-pool cells, each first 25% lifetime capacity labels

methods.random: v8 repeated random acquisition baseline (5 repeats)
methods.representative: v8 six-dimensional target centroid + farthest point
methods.pred_extreme: min and max source-predicted early mean capacity (first 12 cycles)
methods.source_novelty: smallest and largest normalized Euclidean distance to RW training-feature center

interpretation: No strategy improves over random macro average; source novelty near parity with random and improves satellite, but not demonstrated statistical superiority. This is not exact replication of literature methods.
